column1: # RetroArch's content folders (/app0/content/<folder>) and the ES-DE system each
# one is shown as. The ES-DE name selects the system's full name, extensions,
# platform and theme from ES-DE's own es_systems.xml (frontends/es-de/systems.py).
# The core is the system's default, one of the title's (/app0/cores/<core>_libretro.so),
# or "-" for none: RetroArch's playlists choose a game's core first (src/ps5_game.h),
# and a game with no core anywhere is refused back to ES-DE with the reason.
